node.title: Mapping — Maya's incident-to-cause pain → Observe
node.summary: Maps the 'trail goes cold at every tool boundary' pain to the Observe graph that joins the chain and reaches the one missing repo rule.
node.interview_question: What does 'the trail goes cold' look like in a real customer's stack, and how many boundaries does Observe actually cross unaided?

competitor.name: Rootly
competitor.positioning: Rootly/incident.io own incident→PR causation and the on-call's trust; they argue root-cause lives in the incident tool, not an analytics graph.
